cohort: The study included 440 women selected via simple random sampling from the West Shewa Zone of Oromia, Ethiopia, who had recently given birth.
finding: Disrespectful maternity care was significantly associated with both maternal (AOR = 2.22) and neonatal-related complications (AOR = 2.78) during childbirth.
cross-section timing: The study collected data through face-to-face interviews, implying it captured experiences around the time of childbirth.
